content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a good week. I am reviewing the agreement and have one minor point to discuss before signing. - Regarding the clause starting with 'EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF', your indemnification or other obligations under Paragraph 9 are excluded from the liability cap, leaving you exposed to unlimited damages for those claims. I propose changing this to: 'Except with respect to your indemnification obligations, your maximum liability to the Client shall be limited to the fees paid under this Agreement.' I look forward to finalizing this. Best regards,
